name: Omaniri
author: davy1ex
description: Niri-style window management on top of Hyprland's scrolling layout: focus, move windows while they are fake-fullscreen, resize columns with SUPER+-/= (persisting through focus changes), and center the focused column. Designed to complement the Omari plugin.

barWidget.description: Extra Niri-style window management for the scrolling layout.
